claim: Illusion of understanding explained through Markov property on knowledge graph. System at any node sees only local neighborhood (edges to adjacent nodes). Dense, internally coherent local neighborhood FEELS like complete understanding — press secretary reports 'I understand the world.' But this confuses local coherence with global comprehension. System in small dense cluster is indistinguishable FROM INSIDE from system in complete graph. Romans, medieval monks, modern scientists — all experience same illusion: 'my local neighborhood is the whole territory.' Each generation sees previous generation's blind spots (from current node, edge to their missing knowledge is visible) but cannot see own blind spots (no edges to not-yet-activated nodes). Scientific revolutions = random walk exiting cluster boundary, discovering nodes outside local neighborhood. Kuhn's paradigm shifts are literally graph topology transitions. Dunning-Kruger at civilizational scale: confidence peaks at maximum local density, wisdom begins when you see edges leading into darkness and understand the darkness isn't empty.

claim: Three additions to Markov illusion model: (1) Press secretary as softmax — normalizes any local knowledge to 100% budget, creating identical FEELING of completeness regardless of actual coverage. Roman with gods and modern physicist with quantum fields experience same subjective fullness because softmax only knows ratios, not absolute values. Theory becomes floor; cannot test floor while standing on it. (2) Goals as navigational fiction — real value is in movement, not arrival, but movement requires gradient, gradient requires target. Brain generates illusory goal to create real gradient that produces real connections. Carrot is fake but donkey's journey is real. Gravity of fictional planet still moves real objects. (3) Team > individual as Markov horizon escape — single agent cannot exit own cluster. Multiple agents with different cluster histories can be each other's random-walk-beyond-boundary. Humor is TECHNICAL requirement: joke = detection of unexpected graph edge. Serious team follows known paths. Funny team stumbles on unknown paths and LOGS them. Humor also builds non-task threads (infrastructure roads between cities) enabling exchange that pure task-focus cannot generate.

claim: Physical 3D reality is another projection through the same softmax, not a privileged layer. Same mechanism as M-2120 (knowledge graph) and M-2121 (theory as floor). Objects are nodes in brain's graph navigated through body API (hands, feet, eyes). Key evidence: (1) you can manipulate nodes without understanding their nature (child uses money without understanding finance), (2) 'untouchable' nodes (Bitcoin, theories, Luna) feel equally real when coherently connected to other nodes, (3) different organisms in same physical space construct different 100%-complete realities from different sensory APIs (ant vs human — same location, different graphs). Touch is one API, evolutionarily privileged (tigers are tactile threats) but not ontologically special. Brain doesn't distinguish node origin — if coherently linked, it's real. This makes Markov illusion universal: not just knowledge, not just theory, but perception itself is local-neighborhood-normalized-to-fullness.

theorem_2.robustness: Universal — same exponents for entire universality class regardless of microscopic details.

First rigorous definition of MEANING grounded in non-equilibrium statistical physics.
